symptom: Fresh ready PRs on reused or stale candidate heads appeared to have zero pull_request workflow runs, but later current-main reconciliation showed the affected lineages were heavily stale or conflicted.
provenEvidence: A stale and conflicted candidate lineage was observed roughly 148 commits behind current main and overlapped shared learning and prevention contracts.
A fresh candidate created from current main immediately received normal pull_request workflow runs.
The exact GitHub internal scheduling cause was not independently reproduced or proven.
failedApproaches: Treat zero head_sha workflow results as proof of a GitHub scheduling defect.
Close and reopen the same stale PR and repeat the same trigger hypothesis.
Create another ref on the same stale or conflicted commit before checking current-main lineage and mergeability.
requiredPreDiagnosisChecks: check file and semantic overlap against current main
safeRule: An agent must not diagnose a pull_request workflow scheduling failure until current-main freshness, PR mergeability, and file or semantic overlap have been checked. If stale or conflicted lineage exists, reconcile lineage first and keep the platform cause UNKNOWN.
promotionRule: Promote this observation to PROVEN only after the scheduling cause and deterministic recovery are independently reproduced on a current, mergeable, non-overlapping candidate.
